title: Optimize individual repository page loading
summary: Reduced the repository page critical loading path by removing unused repository-wide snapshot and repository-index queries, replacing detail-derived sidebar counts with snapshot summary counts, and deferring the expensive snapshot detail fan-out until Activity or Artifacts is opened.
userVisibleChange: Individual repository pages reach their initial content faster and no longer load every snapshot detail in the background before detail-heavy tabs are used.

risks.title: Activity and artifact tabs fetch details when first opened
risks.mitigation: The existing detail query remains cached for 30 seconds after the deferred load and behavior is covered by the tab-loading regression test.

timeline.title: Measured repository page loading
timeline.summary: Measured repository snapshots at about 0.83s, pull requests at about 3.8s, and 102 eager snapshot detail requests totaling about 1.0MB and 11.6s of aggregate request time.

timeline.title: Deferred non-critical repository data
timeline.summary: Removed unused global/list queries and gated full snapshot details by active tab.

timeline.title: Ran UI and Go verification
timeline.summary: UI tests, production UI build, embedded UI Go package tests, and whitespace checks passed.

decisions.title: Load snapshot details on demand
decisions.rationale: The overview, snapshots, code, compare, and pull-request tabs can render from snapshot summaries; only Activity and Artifacts need full detail payloads.

decisions.title: Use summary counts for the sidebar
decisions.rationale: Decision and risk counts are already included in EvolutionSummary, so the initial page does not need full snapshot documents to render repository statistics.

decisions.title: Keep short-lived query freshness
decisions.rationale: A 30-second stale window avoids unnecessary repeat fetches while runtime events continue to invalidate changed repository data.

validation.output: TypeScript check and Vite production build passed.
